description:
Update single Inspection Log.

#### See - [Daily Log guide](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/daily-logs) - for additional info on
* Attachments
* Locations

rejection_reason.description: Reason given when the log was rejected. Null when no reason was given or the log is not rejected.

rejected_by.description: User who rejected the log. Null when the log is not rejected.

id.description: ID of the user who rejected the log.

name.description: Name of the user who rejected the log.

company.description: The rejecting user's company (vendor) in the project company's directory. Null when the user has no vendor.

rejected_at.description: Timestamp when the log was rejected. Null when the log is not rejected.

id.description: Unique identifier for the inspection log.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the inspection log was created.

inspecting_entity.description: Type of inspector performing the inspection

position.description: Order in which this entry was recorded for the day

status.description: Approval state of the inspection log.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the inspection log.
Timestamp of last update to Location

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this vendor/company.

name.description: Display name of the vendor or contractor company.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the segment was soft deleted

deleted.description: Indicates if the segment is deleted

400.description: Can not update due to errors

403.description: User does not have right permissions

409.description: Conflict. A rejection reason was sent for a log that is already rejected, and either the log already has a reason or a non-null reason was sent.

date.description: Date of inspection. Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example: 2016-04-19

datetime.description: Datetime of record. Mutually exclusive with the date property.

inspecting_entity.description: Type of inspector performing the inspection

location_id.description: The ID of the Location of the Inspection Log. `location_id` takes precedence over `mt_location`

mt_location.description: Use this for creating a new multi-tier or single-tier Location. This will be ignored if `location_id` is provided.

items.description: Look at Daily Log Guide for more info.

vendor_id.description: ID of the Vendor associated to the inspection log
